individual-data-points.explanation: Flow cytometry pseudocolor/dot plots where each point represents an individual cell event; no averaged/aggregated summary statistic requiring overlay of individual points.
Flow cytometry scatter/dot plots showing individual cell events directly; not a bar/summary chart of averages.

Color-coded overlay scatter plots of individual cells from different populations (MBC, GC, naive); each dot is an individual data point, not an average.
Flow cytometry gating scatter plots showing individual cell events; no summary/average statistic depicted that would require individual point overlay.
